source.credential_check: OPENCODE_API_KEY presence only; value not read or retained

redaction_policy: mount or pass authentication read-only and never inspect credential values
retain raw OpenCode JSONL and stderr only below the ignored artifact destination
retain prompt and runtime session identifiers only as SHA-256 in tracked evidence
omit authorization headers, credential values, raw cache keys, and namespaces
retain normalized evidence separately from raw OpenCode output
claim_limits: OpenCode model steps are not native provider request counts
OpenCode does not expose the provider-visible composed prefix or a cache key in step-finish
session continuity is runtime routing or key-partition evidence, not provider cache isolation
aggregate token movement cannot supply an unavailable control or provider-internal miss reason
